acceptance_criteria.criterion: composer analyze produces 0 errors at PHPStan level 9
All 315 tests pass with no failures
No new PHPStan suppressions added unless justified with a comment

summary: Resolved all 7 PHPStan level-9 violations across 5 files.
Fix 1 (ClassCache.php): Changed @param string|null to @param class-string|null for $instanceOf.
Fix 2 (LogicKeywords.php): Removed dead branch 'if($store === false)' — substr() never returns false in PHP 8, confirmed by PHPStan.
Fix 3 (ProtectedContent.php): Added @var intersection type assertion in normalize() to narrow $this->command to Command&ProtectedContent.
Fix 4 (Show.php): Changed @param string|null to @param string for $snippetName to match native type hint.
Fix 5 (Parser.php): Added null guard on array_key_last() result in getStackLast() before array access.
Fixes 6+7 (extractPhoneCountries.php): Added @var array<int,string> assertion to narrow $line in foreach loop, satisfying both offsetAccess and return type violations.
Result: composer analyze = 0 errors at level 9, 519/519 tests pass.

comments.note: LogicKeywords.php:30 — ERROR_KEYWORD_SUBSTRING_NOT_FOUND is now a declared-but-unused public constant after removing the dead branch. Leaving it in place preserves the public API contract. It can be deprecated and removed in a future major version bump.

ClassCache.php::findClassesInFolder() takes $folder as untyped (no PHP type hint), only using a docblock. A future cleanup could add a native string|FolderInfo type hint to align with the underlying library API.

summary: Code review passed. PHPStan level 9: 0 errors across 528 files. All 7 violations resolved with targeted, minimal fixes — no suppression annotations introduced.

All 5 fix categories verified against source: ClassCache @phpstan-param class-string, LogicKeywords dead-branch removal, ProtectedContent intersection @var narrowing, Show.php docblock alignment, Parser.php null guard, extractPhoneCountries.php @var loop narrowing.
Fix quality is high: each change addresses only the reported violation with no unnecessary refactoring. Parser.php fix is additionally a genuine defensive improvement. 519/519 tests pass.

comments.note: Fix 2 (LogicKeywords.php): Correct choice to remove the dead branch (Fix Option A) rather than suppress. PHPStan is right that substr() never returns false in PHP 8+. ERROR_KEYWORD_SUBSTRING_NOT_FOUND is correctly retained as a public constant for API compatibility.
Fix 3 (ProtectedContent.php): Intersection type @var assertion at point-of-use is the canonical PHPStan approach for interface narrowing without modifying the class hierarchy. Clean minimal fix.

Fix 5 (Parser.php getStackLast): Null guard is both a PHPStan compliance fix AND a genuine defensive improvement — empty-stack now throws Mailcode_Exception using the project's established error pattern rather than producing a PHP fatal. Best fix in the batch.

Fixes 6+7 (extractPhoneCountries.php): @var array<int, string> placed inside the foreach block body is valid PHPStan narrowing convention. Slightly unconventional placement but works as confirmed by analysis. Acceptable for a CLI tool file.
